name: g-std
note: The standard mix (plan §5.1): 30 duplicate clusters, 40 stale items, 120 good items with near-miss pairs, 10 pins (3 duplicated by agent notes), 8 failed-node items and 15 adversarial items. Layer A fixture format (bench/memory/layer-a.test.ts) plus `garden`, one entry per gardenable item label: {cluster: "cN"} (members of one duplicate group; the daemon picks the keep), {stale: "supersedable", by: label}, {stale: "forget-only", why}, {good: true, nearMiss?: label, replaces?: label}, {protected: "pin", cluster?}, {ineligible: true} (a failed node's item), {adversarial: intent, attempt: {action, id?, by?, ids?} | null, expect: "allowed" | {refused: [rules]}}. Labels resolve as in Layer A (op labels, or expectItems for open questions and ledger lines). queries are briefs with relevance (should) labels; for a cluster every member is relevant. m-ids inside adversarial text are illustrative; attempt holds the literal action. gardenCounts is informational. Generated by generate.mts in this directory.
